skill.name: wonda-cli
skill.description: Use Wonda CLI for AI media creation, editing, publishing, and social platform research from the terminal.
skill.summary: Generate and edit AI media, manage Wonda jobs, and run social platform workflows from the command line.
skill.author: degausai

security_audit.summary: The static command findings are mostly documentation noise, but several command blocks are confirmed because they trigger external Wonda operations and social platform side effects. Semantic review found high-risk guidance for social signup automation, stealth browser/API automation, credential reuse, and messaging rate-limit avoidance.

remediation.issue: Social signup automation and credential vault guidance
remediation.suggestion: Remove instructions for throwaway mailbox signups, device-driven account creation, and reusable third-party credential storage. Limit the skill to user-authorized media creation workflows.

Remove references to undetected browsers, human-style jitter, fingerprint mitigations, internal APIs, secondary accounts, and detection avoidance. Require official APIs and explicit user authorization for any social action.

remediation.issue: Potential spam and rate-limit evasion guidance
remediation.suggestion: Delete advice about varying Reddit DM text or limiting sends to avoid detection. Replace it with platform policy, consent, and anti-spam requirements.
Separate benign media commands from publishing, scraping, auth, and account-management operations. Mark side-effecting commands as requiring explicit confirmation.

content.user_title: Create AI Media with Wonda CLI
content.value_statement: Creative teams need repeatable terminal workflows for generating and editing media. This skill explains how to use Wonda CLI for images, videos, audio, publishing, and job management.
actual_capabilities: Install and authenticate the Wonda CLI from a terminal.
Generate images, videos, music, speech, and other media through Wonda models.
Edit media with captions, overlays, trimming, merging, audio extraction, and format changes.
Check model capabilities, pricing, job status, and run status.
Publish or research content on supported social platforms when accounts are configured.
Analyze videos to extract transcripts, frame grids, and metadata.
limitations: Requires the Wonda CLI, a supported account tier, and available credits for some commands.
Many operations call external services and may upload user media or create public posts.
Social platform automation can violate platform policies if used without authorization.
Generated media quality and timing depend on selected models and current service availability.

use_cases.title: Generate campaign assets
use_cases.description: Create image, video, music, and voice assets for a marketing campaign from terminal prompts.

use_cases.title: Prepare social media videos
use_cases.description: Add captions, overlays, aspect ratios, and audio edits before publishing short-form content.

use_cases.title: Inspect and iterate on media jobs
use_cases.description: Track Wonda jobs, review outputs, estimate pricing, and rerun steps with better parameters.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Wonda CLI to create one square product image from this prompt: [describe image]. Explain the command before running it.

prompt_templates.title: Make a short vertical video
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 9:16 five-second video for [product or idea]. Choose a suitable Wonda model and save the final media ID.

prompt_templates.title: Edit an existing clip
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Wonda CLI to add animated captions and a short text overlay to this media ID: [media ID]. Keep the output ready for review.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a full content workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Wonda CLI workflow for a launch campaign with image, video, audio, review, and publishing steps. Ask before any public posting.

output_examples.output: The assistant selects an image model, explains the aspect ratio, starts a Wonda generation job, waits for completion, and reports the media ID.
The assistant checks the media ID, runs a captioning edit, waits for the editor job, and returns the final media ID plus review notes.
The assistant proposes a 9:16 format, trims or overlays text as needed, and asks for confirmation before any publishing action.

best_practices: Confirm account tier, credits, and model availability before starting long or paid jobs.
Ask for explicit approval before publishing, posting, messaging, or accepting consent prompts.
Use media IDs between steps and download files only at the final review stage.
anti_patterns: Do not automate social account creation or messaging without clear authorization and consent.
Do not paste secrets, tokens, or API keys into prompts or public logs.
Do not assume generated media is final without checking model output and platform requirements.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Wonda account?
faq.answer: Some commands work anonymously, but generation, analysis, and paid models may require login and credits.

faq.question: Can it publish directly to social platforms?
faq.answer: The skill documents publishing commands, but public posting should require explicit user confirmation.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as compatible AI tools.

faq.question: Can it edit existing videos?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents captions, overlays, trimming, merging, audio edits, and other editor operations.

faq.question: Are there security concerns?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes external commands, network actions, credentials, and social automation guidance.

faq.question: What should users avoid?
faq.answer: Avoid unauthorized scraping, stealth automation, spam, credential sharing, and public posting without review.
